nominal_event_timing.qualification: Conditional no-halt, no-reset, less-than-one-DWT-wrap arithmetic. Event stamp follows publication/decision; not IRQ duration, calibrated time or atomic bank sampling.

nominal_timing.qualification: Conditional modulo arithmetic: assumes uninterrupted DWT and less than one wrap. Includes IRQ and observer work; not CPU share, calibrated time or WCET.

limits: These are saved bytes and declared identity pins; physical image/readback and operator chronology are separate evidence.
positive_bytes are known DATA FIFO acceptance before freeze, not USB delivery, complete frames or committed sample prefix.
Unknown writes and unsaved partial prepare time cannot be reconstructed from zero counts.
The final no-positive interval includes the tail through first close; without positives it starts at begin.
250ms cap is a checkpoint for observation only; actual end and overshoot are retained.
No throughput fix, losslessness, analog accuracy or calibrated sampling rate follows from a valid record.
Gate24 has no embedded session/image identity: saved64/136, declared pins, exact source/readback and single-boot chronology are separate evidence.
The publication serial is an EP0x82 transfer cookie, not DATA sequence, sample count or USB packet count; queued bytes are staged in PMA, not host delivery.
APPLICABLE names the last episode before N CLOSING only. USB64 is later: HELD0 exposes skew, HELD1 never proves the same episode. Current64 attribution is always unavailable.
Grant, other ISR, failed submit, lifecycle and sticky-invalid history cannot be treated as the current held cause. Unknown fields stay unknown.
CAP is an observation checkpoint, not acquisition stop; this bank cannot explain a later failure.
Evaluated age is the existing modulo TIM2 decision operand, not a fresh freeze-time measurement or a 500us WCET guarantee.
No stable sampling/USB throughput, losslessness or analog accuracy follows from a valid diagnostic record.
